notes: Updater fixed: the update helper now survives the app closing.
patch_notes: The automatic update hand-off was rebuilt. When you click Update, the app now hands finish_update.bat to Explorer (the Windows shell) instead of starting it itself. A helper started by the app kept dying together with the app it had just closed - that is why the console opened, closed, and nothing was rebuilt or relaunched, while the same file double-clicked in Explorer always worked. A batch handed to Explorer is completely independent of the app, exactly like a manual double-click. The helper also logs a 'relaunch issued' line at the end now, so any future problem leaves clear evidence in update_build.log.
